Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misframed the task by conflating “has worked in France since” with “professor at CPT/Marseille since,” narrowing the scope to Marseille/CPT. This led to treating “2004 (professor in Marseille)” as conflicting with “2000 (working in France),” when they describe different milestones. This misinterpretation risks yielding the wrong year and drove unnecessary conflict-resolution steps rather than recognizing both statements can be simultaneously true.
